Triangular-sampler priors (large BVAR, shrinkage, stochastic volatility)

Source: R/bvar.R
prior_triangular.Rd

Prior for the equation-by-equation sampler of bvarm() (Carriero, Clark & Marcellino 2019 style): structural equation \(i\) regresses \(y_i\) on lags, deterministics and the contemporaneous \(y_1,\dots,y_{i-1}\). Variables are therefore ordered: the reduced-form fit is order-dependent in the prior (not in the likelihood).

Usage

prior_triangular(
  type = c("minnesota", "ssvs", "horseshoe"),
  lambda1 = 0.2,
  lambda2 = 0.5,
  alpha = 2,
  lambda3 = 100,
  lambda5 = 10,
  delta = 1,
  rho = 0.1,
  inclusion = 0.5,
  hom = c(3, 2)
)

Arguments

type

"minnesota", "ssvs" or "horseshoe".

lambda1

overall tightness (also the SSVS slab scale).

lambda2

cross-variable shrinkage factor (Minnesota).

alpha

lag-decay exponent.

lambda3

prior sd multiplier (times s_i) of deterministic coefficients.

lambda5

prior sd multiplier of the contemporaneous coefficients \(a_{ij}\).

delta

prior mean of the own first lag (1 random walk, 0 stationary).

rho

SSVS spike-to-slab sd ratio.

inclusion

SSVS prior inclusion probability.

hom

prior c(a0, b0) for constant variances when sv = FALSE: IG(a0, b0 s_i^2).

Value

a prior_triangular object.

Details

The base prior variance of the coefficient on lag \(l\) of variable \(j\) in equation \(i\) is \(\frac{s_i^2}{s_j^2 l^{\alpha}}\) (\(s\) = AR residual sd), multiplied by

  • minnesota: \(\lambda_1^2\) (own lags) or \(\lambda_1^2\lambda_2^2\) (other lags);

  • ssvs: slab \(\lambda_1^2\) or spike \(\rho^2\lambda_1^2\) by a Bernoulli inclusion indicator;

  • horseshoe: \(\tau_i^2\lambda_{ij}^2\) with half-Cauchy global/local scales (data-driven shrinkage).

See also

Other Bayesian VAR: autoplot.mcmc_diagnostics(), bvarm(), mcmc_diagnostics(), prior_minnesota(), tidy.bvarm(), volatility()
